name: Murder
description: Whoever commits murder shall be punished.
punishment: Death penalty or imprisonment for life and fine.

name: Attempt to Murder
description: Attempting to commit murder, with intent to cause death.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years, life imprisonment, or fine.

name: Culpable Homicide
description: Causing death with the intention of causing death or bodily injury.
punishment: Imprisonment for life or imprisonment for 10 years and fine.

name: Rape
description: Sexual assault without consent or against the will of a woman.
punishment: Rigorous imprisonment of not less than 10 years, which may extend to life, and fine.

name: Definition of Rape
description: Defines the act of rape and conditions under which it is considered an offence.
punishment: As per Section 376.

name: Cruelty by Husband or Relatives
description: Husband or relatives subjecting a woman to cruelty or harassment.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine.

name: Voluntarily Causing Hurt
description: Causing hurt intentionally without grave provocation.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine or both.

name: Voluntarily Causing Hurt with Dangerous Weapons
description: Causing hurt using weapons or means likely to cause death.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both.

name: Outraging Modesty of a Woman
description: Assault or use of criminal force to outrage a woman's modesty.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine.

name: Kidnapping
description: Kidnapping or abducting a person.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.

name: Kidnapping for Ransom
description: Kidnapping for ransom or causing harm.
punishment: Death penalty or life imprisonment and fine.

name: Theft
description: Dishonest removal of property belonging to another person.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both.

name: Robbery
description: Committing theft using violence or causing fear of injury.
punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine.

name: Dacoity
description: Committing robbery with 5 or more persons.
punishment: Rigorous imprisonment up to life and fine.

name: Cheating and Dishonest Inducement
description: Cheating someone to deliver property or valuable security.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine.

name: Voluntarily Causing Grievous Hurt
description: Causing grievous hurt using dangerous weapons.
punishment: Imprisonment up to life or up to 10 years and fine.

name: Criminal Trespass
description: Entry into property with intent to commit an offence.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 months or fine or both.

name: Insulting Modesty of a Woman
description: Word, gesture, or act intended to insult modesty of a woman.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year and fine.

name: Cohabitation Caused by Deceitful Promise of Marriage
description: Deceiving a woman into cohabitation by false promise of marriage.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine.

name: Culpable Homicide Not Amounting to Murder
description: Causing death without intention to cause death.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 10 years or life and fine.

name: Rash Driving
description: Driving any vehicle rashly endangering human life.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 6 months or fine or both.

name: Grievous Hurt
description: Inflicting injury that seriously affects health or body.
punishment: Imprisonment for life or up to 10 years and fine.

name: Obscene Acts in Public
description: Doing obscene acts or singing obscene songs in public.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 months or fine or both.

name: Criminal Conspiracy
description: Agreement to commit an illegal act.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 6 months or as per intended offence.

name: Abetment
description: Instigating or aiding another person to commit an offence.
punishment: Same as the offence abetted.

name: Acts Done by Several Persons with Common Intention
description: Criminal acts done in furtherance of common intention.
punishment: Same as the main offence.

name: Waging War Against Friendly Nation
description: Waging or attempting to wage war against a friendly nation.
punishment: Imprisonment for life or up to 7 years and fine.

name: Promoting Enmity Between Groups
description: Promoting enmity between groups on grounds of religion, race, etc.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both.

name: Public Servant Disobeying Law
description: A public servant knowingly disobeying the law.
punishment: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine or both.
